name: design-prompt-provenance
goal: Preserve entity provenance and requested-area boundaries in reference-aware image prompts.

evidence: Commit b0f7feb536 replaced the prior Entity: title label when adding reference-aware scope instructions. At 5848e9de2d the existing visual-provenance case fails on that missing label; the entity title itself remains present.

The existing desktop run-integration case detects the regression. The earlier scoped-prompt work had no passing result for that consumer case on the integrated revision; keep the existing case in normal desktop verification and run it alongside the design-reference matrix.
